description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the PimDefinedReportDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests CRUD operations related to PIM (Personal Information Management) reports, including listing, retrieving, saving, and updating reports within the PIM module.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class to verify the functionality of ReportGeneratorDao's operations related to PIM reports, including listing, retrieval by ID, saving, and updating reports.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup before any tests run; populates fixture data for report groups, filter fields, and display fields.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment; initializes the ReportGeneratorDao instance and populates test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetPimDefinedReportList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of PIM-defined reports; checks the count and object type.

methods.name: testDeletePimDefinedReportList
methods.description: Tests deleting specific reports by IDs; verifies the number of deleted reports.

methods.name: testGetPimDefinedReportById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a report by its ID and validating its properties.

methods.name: testSavePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new PIM report with associated filter fields; asserts that the saved report has correct properties.

methods.name: testUpdatePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Tests updating an existing report and verifying that the changes are persisted correctly.
